How booking works

Three simple steps

  1. 01

    Choose your treatment

    Browse the menu, or tell us what you have in mind if you are unsure.

  2. 02

    Send a request

    Share your preferred date and time using the short booking form.

  3. 03

    We confirm personally

    We will get back to you to confirm your appointment. Your time is not booked until we do.
